risks.risk: Exact dimensions (table height/length and TV stand width/height) may not fit the buyer’s space.
risks.proof: Ask for a tape-measure photo showing: centre table (L x W x H) and TV stand (W x D x H) from edge to edge.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic set with unknown dimensions (worst-case for fit: assume may not match buyer needs).

risks.risk: Material quality (particle board vs solid wood vs MDF/veneer vs metal/glass) affects durability and resale value.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the underside/edges and any visible joinery, plus a photo of the back panel/underside.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as lower-grade furniture (e.g., MDF/particle board) until material is confirmed.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in the photo (chips, scratches, water damage, wobble).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of corners/edges and the glass top surface (including reflections to show scratches), plus a short video showing the table and stand being gently pushed to check wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible cosmetic wear (worst-case: assume scratches/scuffs).

risks.risk: TV stand capacity and stability (top sagging, shelf load limits) are unknown.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo/video showing the stand with a weight test or at least the manufacturer’s stated load rating (if any), and confirm TV size it was used for.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed for heavy TVs (worst-case: assume limited load).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (e.g., mounting hardware, legs, glass support brackets) could reduce usability.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of all included items laid out (legs, screws, brackets, any glass supports) and confirm 'complete set'.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/needs parts until confirmed complete.

proof_requests: Tape-measure photos for both pieces: centre table (L x W x H) and TV stand (W x D x H).
Close-up photos of edges/underside/back to confirm material (MDF/particle/wood/metal) and construction quality.
Corner/edge and glass-top close-ups to assess chips/scratches; include a short video showing stability (no wobble).
Photos of included hardware/parts to confirm the set is complete.
Confirm the TV size it fits (e.g., inches) and whether there are any weight/load limitations.
